raise_justifications.backend/routers/apps.py: App-authored manifest text is pinned by hash at approval and escaped before it reaches a prompt or a tool schema, so a post-approval manifest swap is detected.
raise_justifications.backend/routers/chat.py: Transcription budget no longer silently skipped when a file's duration cannot be parsed; the charge decision belongs to the route that admits the upload.
raise_justifications.backend/routers/developer.py: Developer memory create and batch routes must record their accepted write result at the authoritative API boundary; the shared dev-only allowlisted serializer/exporter lives in testing.parity_pack_v0.live_capture.
raise_justifications.backend/routers/mcp_sse.py: Token revocation now enforced on the MCP sign-in path, which previously let a revoked token mint a 365-day OAuth grant.
raise_justifications.backend/routers/sync.py: Per-request file-count cap on the two audio sync routes, rejected before any part is read.
raise_justifications.backend/routers/users.py: Account-deletion outcome telemetry at the users router boundary for PostHog ownership repair.
raise_justifications.backend/routers/payment.py: Refund/chargeback entitlement revocation plus an idempotency key that survives the customer id being written mid-flight.
